messages:
min - evals: quick heads-up: new pavo-lite-q5 on nightly shows odd behavior on mixed CJK+RTL samples (zh+ar). BLEU down ~2.5 and punctuation flips next to Arabic segments.
arya - runtime: can you paste a tiny failing sample?
min - evals: here — very short.

input: "北京和القاهرة, 发生了事件。"
fp32 -> "Beijing and Cairo, events occurred."
q5  -> "Beijing and القاهرة , events occurred ."

min - evals: whitespace before Arabic comma and extra spaces around punctuation only when CJK precedes Arabic. Not seen in fp32.
ci-bot: pavo-lite-q5 nightly | task mixed_locale_translate | BLEU: 26.7 (-2.5) | samples: 60
kenji - tokenizers: please dump token id windows for the snippet, both bundles.
min - evals: fp32 ids: 101 2345 11 9001 12 300
min - evals: q5   ids: 101 2345 11 9001 12 300
kenji - tokenizers: ids match -> detok stage suspect. Any recent detok changes for streaming or for q* models?
arya - runtime: I rolled a commit last week that swapped detok path to a faster C implementation only used for quant models. Might be doing wrong Unicode join handling.
ops-rita: can we run a quick local detok with fp32 tokenizer against q5 ids to confirm?
min - evals: ran locally.

python snippet:
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
fp = Tokenizer.from_file('bundles/pavo-lite-fp32/tokenizer.json')
print(fp.decode([101,2345,11,9001,12,300]))
# -> "北京和القاهرة, 发生了事件。"

q_detok = my_fast_detok([101,2345,11,9001,12,300])
# -> "北京和 القاهرة , 发生了事件 ."

min - evals: so fp32 tokenizer detok is correct. fast C detok used for q5 seems to insert spaces when it detects RTL scripts after CJK.
kenji - tokenizers: that C detok is new and was supposed to be parity. I'll open a repro and diff the joiners logic. Could be ZWNJ/ZWJ handling.
arya - runtime: temporary rollback option: route quant models to Python detok until C detok parity is proven. I can add a runtime flag.
ops-rita: INF-3600 created. Rolling q5 canary back and toggling detok flag to python for all quant models in canary.
kenji - tokenizers: follow-up: I'll add unit samples with mixed CJK+RTL and explicit assertions for no leading/trailing ASCII spaces around Arabic punctuation. Also add golden decode strings in model bundles for preflight checks.
min - evals: plan sounds good. After packaging + detok fix, I'll re-run mixed-locale suite and post metrics. Leaving thread open until re-run validated. :white_check_mark:
